name: 19711 · Newark, DE
findings: ZIP 19711 (Newark) has 220 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19711 (Newark) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19711 (Newark) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
